book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Xel teling Yesu en e xe nikanzek
Bouk ti eno Yesu di teyoxe xomaxoneing eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o me neil Xoulek Nimza wou xel, de xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing o dalus is teivateiv lam tyip wou e.
Xel neil wou e bei, “Neil wou xa, wang qou lei ngandoung me nikanzek tiyon nanghei inya me ghe di wong lulul tiyon angya? Eti wong lei ngandoung on wou wang?”
Moxo neil elox wou xel, “Ay is ambei nyon ambei teling xam, xam neil wou ay,
gyeik ingwei Yoan lipek moux alis vex, inyon lul wei Anutu eivek tyoung gheyapu yo, o lul wei xomaxoneing o?”
Xel di luk wouma eivek xel venaxow senghoing me neil embei, “Wangwei xey a neimbei lul on Anutu yo, on tyek teling xey, ‘Nambei nya xam seng wongis e?’
Ekom wangwei xey a neimbei, ‘Lul on xomaxoneing o,’ on tyek moux dalus banex xey en qakous, en xel wongis bei Yoan on poropet.”
Om xel lewexe, “Xa se woulek bei inyon lam anghei inya.”
Yesu neil wou xel, “Ay is, tyek a se neil wou xam en lei ngandoung tiwei andi wong lulti beimambei nangya ne.”
Qayeeng pakeing wei xel xukxe yo
Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing tine wou xomaxoneing bei, “Tambiy ti wong e xe xuk wain ti, dom wou eivek xel xukana valu memend bei xel a mi bo xuk vateivek lek. De e venaxow la dei enden lek beyeeng nge.
Lek bouk wei uleing wain eno moxo wong xukxe ti la wou xel wei di yeiteyei wain o, en embei xel dul wain on neing valu wou e. Ekom xel wei di yeiteyei wain eno leis e me wong e lox mema bandaing.
Moxo wong xukxe nge lox me la no, ekom xel leis e is no me wo niyalenyeing wou e de wong e lox mema bandaing.
Moxo wong xukxe tiwei yal o lox me la no. Ekom xel leis e wo nol me nex e la myayaing.
“Woyom xuk wain ma neil, ‘Tyek am bong ambei nya? Tyek am bong a neung moux tiwei a laleing vind eno na, bei xel se gwevek e xe qayeeng xeinghembi.’
“Ekom gyeik xel xukana yei e neu di lam, eno xel neil wouma bei, ‘Neu moux tine tyek na qou xuk wain. Xey a leis e mey, de xe venaxow a qou xe xe xuk wain ne.’
Om xel nex moxo la myayaing veil xuk wain de leis e mey. “Om tyek xuk wain ma yon bong vati wou xel?
Moxo tyek nam nyeis xel wei di yeiteyei xuk wain on na mey, de bong xuk wain on wou xel amba.” Gyeik xomaxoneing ngo qayeeng tiyon eno xel neil embei, “Lul ambei nyon eno e se nox qandi no.”
Yesu yei xel kanzek, de teling bei, “Qayeeng tiwei xel byex ne qes ambei nya:

content.text: “‘Qakous mundeeng ti myaxeeng wei xel kamunda pesek,
eno wong ambei qakous tiwei nale me mi byexaxoun xomek o’

content: Xel dalus wei oing me teila lek qakous on tyek bo tiptip. Ekom wangwei qakous tiyon detei lek xelti on tyek bo myapapu.”
Xel putoung wei petieing o me xel lumuki leitata yo di yimexe sakwaing en xel embei zeimaxoun e lutika, en xel woulek bei neil qayeeng pakeing tiyon lek xel. Ekom xel yaleeng en xomaxoneing.
Xel a toung takis wou Sisa

Xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing o mi yei Yesu teyei teyei, bei bong xel valu na xupekeing me gyei e teyei. Me tyoing lek bei xel bombek bei na ngo e xe qayeeng wei embei neil o, en kandek xel bong e na wou lei ngandoung wei seyap o.

Om xel teling wou embei, “Putoung, xa woulek qayeeng wei wang mi neil me ghe mi teyoxe eno mi la bombek, me wang mi neil qayeeng la teyeima wou moux alis vex wei lei laeing o me lei maeing o. Me qayeeng zonghek eno wang mi teyoxe xel en Anutu xe kwa.
Woyom wang wou naleim ambei nya, beip inye teyeimbei xey a toung takis wou Sisa o xe se toung?”
Ekom Yesu woulek bei xel tyoxe e, om neil embei,
“Talex selewa ti wou ay. Inye eti tenu me lei di yeip lek?” Xel neil elox bei, “Sisa.”
Me moxo neil wou xel, “Lul wei Sisa, eno xam ghe bong wou Sisa. De lul wei Anutu, eno xam ghe bong wou Anutu.”
Om xel se teyeimbei tyoxe e en qayeeng wei e neil o ti eivek moux alis vex mendghalus, om xel etek en qayeeng wei neil elox wou xel o, om xel dei kanzek.
Qandi lek veil meyeing me iingama
Xel Sadyusi valu wei mi neil embei xel wei mey, eno tyek se qandi lek. Xel lam wou Yesu is telinyeing ti.

Xel neil embei, “Putoung, Mose byex qayeeng ti nambei nye wou xey, wangwei tambiy ti dii vex ti ekom mey veil venei de neu ma, ond li e dii vexeiv me bong li wei mey eno neu en mendi zeim li lei xoun.
Om xel wei lindama eno lim yuw. Tiwei myaxeeng eno ii vex ti ekom mey de neu ma.
Woyom li nge wei yuw eno ii vexeiv on.
De li tiwei yal eno ii vexeiv. Eivek sakwaing ambei nyon eno xel lim yuw wei lindama eno ii vex tiyon me neuyeiw ma, de xel mey.
Dekakom vex tiyon mey loxyus is.
Woyom gyeik bouk loxyus wei xel meyeing embei qandi lek, eno eti venei vex tiyon? En moux lim yuw eno ii vex tixemou yon.”
Yesu neil elox wou xel, “Xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne mi iima me wong vex lox me loum wouma.
Ekom eivek bouk loxyus eno moux alis vex wei Anutu neil embei xel teyei lek en ingwei xel embei qandi lek veil meyeing me mendei mapieing, eno tyek se diima o bong xel nox me noum wouma.
Me tyek xel se nox me na mey no, en xel on teyei lek xel angela. Me xel on Anutu neuyeiw, en nambei xel qandi lek veil meyeing.

Ekom Mose talex wou xey bei xel wei mey eno tyek qandi lek veil meyeing, en pavulek wei byex en ingwei nenyex tum lek xax nayaka yo, en taxe Tambiy Ngandoung Anutu wei Apraham o me Anutu wei Isaka yo me Anutu wei Yakop o.
Moxo se Anutu wei xel meyeing, qe e Anutu wei xel wei mapieing. En eivek Anutu manghalus eno moux alis vex dalus toundei mapieing en e.”
Xel putoung wei petieing o valu ngo qayeeng wei Yesu neil o, om xel neil wou embei, “Putoung, wa xe qayeeng on nimza.”
De xelti se teyeimbei bong telinyeing wou Yesu en lulti no.
Eti neu Kilisi?
Woyom Yesu neil wou xel bei, “Nambei nya moux alis vex mi neil embei Kilisi yon Dawit Neu Moux?
Dawit venaxow neil eivek Qapiya Lalo bei,

content.text: “ ‘Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou a xe Tambiy Ngandoung bei,
deka a toung wa xe xel vevek na
kwanghembi eivek wang le.” ’ Qapiya Lalo 110:1

content: Dawit taxe e bei ‘Tambiy Ngandoung.’ Nambei nya Kilisi yon Dawit bu?”
Kwa wei xel putoung wei petieing o
Kale xomaxoneing dalus di ngo qayeeng wei Yesu di neil o, de neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei,

“Xam ghe gweiteyei xow en xel putoung wei petieing o, xel laleind mi vind en xel embei mi byex teimb ding me na ghavineeng. Xel laleind mi vind bei xel a mi neil bendiyeing teiv wou xel eivek beyeeng wei xel mi wong vateivek lek lulul o, me xel la mindei lek beyeeng nimza wei mya eivek xomek qekueing ama me xel la mindei lek leitata bend wei mya eivek mata wei ngandoung o.
Xel mi tyoxe xel vexeiv me panax xel xe xomek. De xel mi wou naleind bei xel nimza om xel mi zeimemend wo ding. Bouk loxyus eno tyek xel wei nambei nyon eno tyek na qou myaveweeng ngandoung.”
